gloss: death anniversary; anniversary of someone's death

definitions.gloss: death anniversary; anniversary of someone's death
definitions.explanation: The date on which a person died, observed annually as a day of remembrance. In Japanese Buddhism, this day holds special significance for memorial services and visiting graves.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{祖父|そふ}の{命日|めいにち}だ。
examples.english: Today is the anniversary of my grandfather's death.

examples.japanese: {命日|めいにち}には{毎年|まいとし}{墓参|はかまい}りに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I visit the grave every year on the anniversary of the death.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}の{命日|めいにち}に{家族|かぞく}で{集|あつ}まり、{好|す}きだった{花|はな}を{供|そな}えた。
examples.english: On the anniversary of my mother's death, the family gathered and offered her favorite flowers.

notes:
USAGE:
An important concept in Japanese Buddhist tradition. On the {命日|めいにち}, families typically visit the grave ({墓参|はかまい}り), offer flowers and incense, and hold memorial services. The first anniversary is called {一周忌|いっしゅうき}, and subsequent major anniversaries ({三回忌|さんかいき}, {七回忌|ななかいき}, etc.) are observed with formal ceremonies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命日|めいにち}に{墓参|はかまい}りする (to visit the grave on the death anniversary)
- {命日|めいにち}に{花|はな}を{供|そな}える (to offer flowers on the death anniversary)
- ～の{命日|めいにち} (the anniversary of ~'s death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {忌日|きじつ}: death anniversary — more formal/literary
- {祥月命日|しょうつきめいにち}: the monthly anniversary falling on the same day as the death — the full-year anniversary specifically
